title: MxAgile Decision
description: Canonical schema for a design or business decision. Located at planning/decisions/DEC-NNN.yml. Decisions document deliberate choices that govern requirements, mockups, role permissions, or implementation scope. Every accepted mockup revision must be backed by at least one DEC-NNN entry. See policies/mockup-lifecycle.md.

ID.description: Stable canonical identifier, e.g. DEC-001. Never reused, even after rejection.

title.description: Short human-readable title of the decision (max 80 chars).

status.description: Lifecycle status of this decision. PROPOSED: decision is pending stakeholder or developer confirmation. CONFIRMED: decision has been explicitly accepted and is authoritative. REJECTED: decision was not accepted; a different path was chosen. SUPERSEDED: decision was once CONFIRMED but has been replaced by a newer DEC-NNN (see superseded_by). A SUPERSEDED decision must never be treated as authoritative without explicit re-confirmation.

decision_type.description: Classification of this decision. business: business rule or process choice. technical: implementation technique or architecture. scope: what is in vs. out of scope. role_permission: access rights or capability assignment. mockup_refinement: acceptance of a refined target mockup revision. platform_boundary: clarifies which functionality is delivered by a platform module (e.g. MB_SSO) vs. the application. ux_interaction: interaction design choice (modal, inline expand, popup). data_model: entity or attribute design choice. gap_repair: decision authorising a GAP repair without changing the fachliches Soll.

topic.description: One-line topic summary (e.g. 'Login page scope for CapTrack', 'Role switcher in mockup is test-only').

decision_text.description: The actual decision, stated as a clear declarative sentence. Must be unambiguous enough to act on without additional context.

rationale.description: Why this decision was made. Include the driver (stakeholder request, technical constraint, platform boundary, etc.).

rejected_alternatives.description: Alternative options that were considered and rejected. Each entry is a free-text description of the alternative and briefly why it was not chosen.

owner.description: Role or name of the person who owns this decision (e.g. 'ProductOwner', 'TechLead', 'Stakeholder:Jane').

source.description: Origin of this decision. design_contract: imported from a MxMocketeer Design Contract. stakeholder: explicit stakeholder statement. developer: developer architectural decision. agent: proposed by an AI agent (requires developer confirmation to become CONFIRMED). requirement_conflict: resolution of a conflict between requirements or sources. gap_analysis: result of GAP Verification & Repair analysis.

created_at.description: ISO date when this decision was first recorded.

confirmed_at.description: ISO date when this decision was confirmed. Null when status is PROPOSED or REJECTED.

confirmed_by.description: Who confirmed this decision. Null when status is not CONFIRMED.

superseded_by.description: DEC-NNN identifier of the decision that supersedes this one. Required when status is SUPERSEDED. Null otherwise.

affected_requirements.description: REQ-NNN identifiers of requirements governed or affected by this decision.

affected_screens.description: PAGE-NNN identifiers of UI screens affected by this decision.

affected_mockup_revisions.description: REV-NNN identifiers of mockup revisions that this decision authorized or that resulted from this decision. For decision_type=mockup_refinement, at least one REV-NNN must be listed.

affected_specs.description: SPEC-NNN identifiers of feature specs that this decision changes or constrains.

design_contract_source_id.description: Source ID from a MxMocketeer Design Contract (e.g. 'DEC-001' within the contract namespace). Only set when source=design_contract. Used for ID namespace guard — this is NOT the same as a canonical DEC-NNN without verified mapping.

design_contract_ref.description: Reference to the originating Design Contract in the form '<mockup-id>@revision=<N>'. Set when source=design_contract.

gap_ref.description: Reference to the GAP that prompted this decision (e.g. 'GAP-CAPTRACK-LOGIN-SCOPE'). Set when decision_type=gap_repair or source=gap_analysis.

notes.description: Optional additional context, caveats, or open questions related to this decision.
